$comment: Hand-kept from BURULAŞ (Bursa Büyükşehir Belediyesi company), "Otopark Tarifesi" of the Bursa Şehirlerarası ve Uluslararası Otobüs Terminali car park: https://www.burulas.com.tr/hizmetler/terminal/otopark-tarifesi (undated page, read 2026-10-18; supersedes the older 80 TL table on /bursa-otobus-terminali/hakkinda/). 0-25 min free; "1..12 Saate Kadar" bands as published; the 12-13 ... 23-24 Saat bands are computed from the published rule "12 saatten sonra her saat için 5,00 TL ilave edilir" (290 + 5 per started hour). Past 24 h the app charges the 23-24 Saat price per started day, which overstates the real +5 TL/hour. Matched only to the OSM car park tagged operator "Burulaş Bursa Terminal Otoparkı"; two unnamed OSM car parks beside the terminal (osm-node-3525140237, osm-way-191171828) are left out. Ankara (ANPARK/BELTAŞ 2026 table published only as an image) and Antalya (ANET, no published price table found) have no file yet: see docs/data-source.md.
